bug_summary: cluster_relが呼び出し元で既にOID経由でclose済みのOldHeapのRelationハンドルを保持し続け、Dropで二重にrelation_closeしてrefcountがアンダーフローしクラッシュしていた
pr_title: Remove the unused disarm_closer escape hatch
pr_description: disarm_closer was added for a single call site in cluster_rel to hand off a Relation handle's close ownership manually, but that path doesn't need the extra bookkeeping. This drops the method from Relation along with its use in cluster_rel, leaving OldHeap's Drop as the sole owner of the close.
